description: Chartbeat engagement pings on ping.chartbeat.net/ping, whose site host and account UID ride as h and g. The chartbeat.js loader is not contracted.

params.name: h
params.description: It is the Chartbeat site id, the host where traffic appears in the dashboard. Chartbeat documents it as the `config.domain` value on the ping.
params.fix_hint: Set `h` to the site id from the Chartbeat snippet, usually the site's root domain.

params.name: g
params.description: It is the numeric Chartbeat account UID from `config.uid`.
params.fix_hint: Set `g` to the numeric uid from the Chartbeat snippet.

params.name: p
params.description: It is the page path. Chartbeat documents it as a ping key to check in QA, from `config.path` or the canonical path.
params.fix_hint: Set `p` to the canonical path Chartbeat should report.

params.name: d
params.description: It is the actual domain of the page, which may differ from `h`. Chartbeat documents it as a ping key to check in QA.
params.fix_hint: Set `d` to the page's domain, or the canonical domain when `useCanonicalDomain` is true.

params.name: t
params.description: It is the unique identifier for the page-session. Chartbeat documents each distinct `t` as a separate pageview.
params.fix_hint: Send a stable page-session id in `t` so successive pings on the same view stay together.

params.name: g0
params.description: It is the comma-delimited list of sections from `config.sections`. Chartbeat documents it as a ping key to check in QA.

params.name: g1
params.description: It is the comma-delimited list of authors from `config.authors`. Chartbeat documents it as a ping key to check in QA.

params.name: i
params.description: It is the page title. Chartbeat documents it as present on the first ping of a page-session.
